mentions.name: NavSahyog custom operations software
mentions.description: Custom software built for the nonprofit NavSahyog to run its entire operations and programs and track longitudinal impact. NavSahyog conducts after-school programs for children in Indian villages. This second iteration is built around a domain model designed from the builder's understanding and observations of the organization, after a first version felt like only a simplistic improvement over the NGO's existing vendor-provided app.
mentions.problem: The NGO's existing vendor-provided app was a simplistic fit, and the first iteration of the custom software likewise felt like only a simplistic improvement over it.
mentions.audience: NavSahyog, the not-for-profit, and its management team who run the organization's operations and programs.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am helping a not-for-profit, [NavSahyog](https://navsahyog.org/), build a custom software for their entire operations and programs that also tracks longitudinal impact.
mentions.author: sameersegal
